search.query: | inputlookup ctf_registrations | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" status="registered" | where Team!="" | dedup Team | sort Team
| inputlookup ctf_answers | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | dedup Number | sort Number
| inputlookup ctf_registrations | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" status="registered" | eval User=if(DisplayUsername="",Username,DisplayUsername) | dedup User | sort User

index=scoreboard_admin ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | eval User=coalesce(DisplayUsername,user) | eval Question=if(Result="Hint",Question." -- Hint #".HintNumber.": ".Hint,Question) | eval ScoreImpact=BasePointsAwarded+SpeedBonusAwarded+AdditionalBonusAwarded-Penalty | search Team=$team$ Number=$number$ User="$myuser$" | table _time Result ScoreImpact Number Question Answer AnswerOfficial user User Team | sort - _time
